session.topic: Unified Helm chart design for db-permissions (the path NOT taken — superseded by sentra-least-privileges TF monorepo)
session.useful_as: Shows the design churn — single Helm chart approach was iterated before the team converged on the native TF monorepo

narrative_arc.spine: The AD designed an access-control plane built on Crossplane v2 + Atlas K8s Operator + Pulumi/ESO. The repo (sentra-least-privileges) shipped something materially different: a single-state Terraform monorepo that talks directly to the four SaaS / IaaS control planes (AWS IdC, Atlas, Okta, Entitle) — zero Crossplane, zero Helm, zero K8s. Walk the four sub-system responsibilities (Credential Delivery, Access Governance, DX, Platform Ops) and contrast Designed vs Shipped, with the why for each divergence.
narrative_arc.tension: Designed (AD.md): Crossplane plane + Atlas Operator + Pulumi+ESO. Shipped (sentra-least-privileges): native TF monorepo with no K8s in the loop. The only Crossplane residue is a historical IAM role name, tag drift on PSes (PR #7), and a legacy charts/ dir flagged superseded.

key_divergences.designed: Crossplane v2 on platform-tools owns Atlas roles + AWS IdC PSes
key_divergences.shipped: TF modules own them directly; charts/ is legacy
key_divergences.why: Crossplane provider-aws-sso-admin + provider-mongodbatlas couldn't express the federation IdP + role-mapping shape; native TF maps 1:1 to the upstream APIs.

key_divergences.designed: Atlas Identity Federation deferred (ADR-008) — humans on SAML, services on stored pw
key_divergences.shipped: Atlas Workforce OIDC federation provisioned in mongodb/federation.tf + role_mappings.tf
key_divergences.why: OIDC federation became viable in Atlas; mongosh OIDC + Okta groups claim wired end-to-end.

key_divergences.designed: GHA cron → Okta sentra-db-admins → Atlas SAML + IdC PS (Pattern C, ADR-001)
key_divergences.shipped: Entitle (BeyondTrust) workflows + bundles + JIT group adopted by TF — DB Access Approval + Break-glass workflows live
key_divergences.why: Entitle gives a per-request approval/audit trail + Slack flow that the GHA-cron pattern couldn't; the GHA cron is the fallback when Entitle is down.

key_divergences.designed: Pulumi (Python) for cloud, ESO for secret delivery
key_divergences.shipped: Native Terraform; no Pulumi / no ESO in this repo (those live in sentra-infrastructure for the service-pod credential path, which is out of scope here)
key_divergences.why: This repo only owns the human-access + role-shape surface; service-pod credentials remain Pulumi+ESO in sentra-infrastructure.
